messages:
Noah (PM): FinReg asked for a previewable, signable upgrade plan for private deployments. goal: no route flips during preview, auditable proof for legal, and a CLI flow netops can run offline. can we sketch minimal acceptance criteria?
Kaya (Eng): shortlist: exportable plan (YAML), dry-run that writes sentinel resources only, preflight validation for BGP/IP/CRD compatibility, and smoke tests gated by metrics.
Omar (Infra): operator-shim required for mirror mode later, but not for preview. preview can be purely control-plane level; mirror/inject will be follow-up. infra impact: none for preview.
Tess (Field): customer wants plan signing (HSM or customer KMS) so they can verify the plan in prod without sharing keys. also offline approval token.
Ivy (Security): ok to sign plans with customer KMS if they provide a key handle. need audit fields: actor id, git sha, plan-hash, pre/post-config-hash, timestamp, key-id. telemetry off by default.
Ben (Solutions): CLI proposal: `redwoodctl upgrade --mode=preview --export=plan.yaml --sign-with=<kms-key>`. preview generates plan.yaml and plan.sig. netops can verify with `redwoodctl verify plan.yaml plan.sig`.
Noah (PM): acceptance criteria draft: 1) plan export + signature 2) preflight checks (BGP neighbor, ASN preservation, CRD/DB compat) 3) dry-run sentinel apply 4) smoke test (15m) + metric gates (P99 <= baseline *1.02) 5) audit bundle export. ship preview in 4w, mirror cutover later.
Kaya (Eng): agree. caveat: KV schema compatibility may need model-compat matrix; will add dataset tests.
Omar (Infra): will scope patch to allow `sentinel=true` apply; minimal change.
Tess (Field): I'll validate plan schema with customer's netops and provide sample plan by EOW.
Ivy (Security): prepping signing flow doc and retention policy for audit bundles.
Ben (Solutions): will draft preview CLI UX and YAML schema.
ci-bot: nightly build: registry.redwood/privdeploy:preview-176130-20260324 uploaded.
Noah (PM): action items: Ben schema, Kaya preflight PoC, Omar sentinel flag, Ivy signing doc, Tess customer validation. check-in in 48h.
